messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.66
parts:
A new version of R/qtl (1.66) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

This is a tiny bug fix, of new compiler warnings on CRAN.

Karl Broman
